chapter: Back to Los Angeles and joining Basie
title: Reuniting with Evans and Roberts, a month at the Reno Club
summary: Herschel Evans and Caughey Roberts joined him in a nine-piece Basie band at the Reno Club for about a month.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: You'd left Herschel Evans out on the West Coast?

Yes. So Herschel, Basie later sent for Caughey Roberts, the fellow who played first alto with me in China and Herschel came together. And before we left Kansas City all of us were in there. Herschel, myself, Caughey and we didn't have but nine pieces and in order to play some of the places we went, we had to have at least fourteen, fifteen.
And the first job we got was in the Grand Terrace, he that wasn't the first job, but one of the first ones.
Well just before you leave Kansas City how long did you play there in this band with Basie?
Oh, not more than that? Was this when you were in the Reno?
